svg.title: A chemical / product tanker at dusk
svg.desc: Hand-drawn animated sketch of a chemical and oil product tanker riding a gentle swell: accommodation and funnel aft, a long flat deck with catwalk, pipes and a midships manifold, a foremast with a blinking masthead light, smoke from the funnel and waves sliding past.

g.text: chemical / product tanker · loaded, on passage
